method: Manual whole-file reading of WdsListControl header and implementation in complete ranges; pinned bytes verified. No Windows execution.
findings: Owner-data rows are retained in pointer vector plus pointer-to-index map. Insert/remove/sort rebuild affected indexes and preserve selected/focused identities via pointer snapshots. Duplicate pointer admission is not rejected, so callers must preserve uniqueness for map/ownership consistency.

SelectionPreserver restores focus only if resulting row is inside viewport; selected identities and selection mark can be restored elsewhere. No scroll-anchor preservation is implemented by this helper.

Stable sorting uses primary then secondary subitems; Compare values with magnitude>=2 preserve direction irrespective of descending, supporting tree ancestor precedence. Arbitrary comparator values including INT_MIN are not guarded before abs.

InsertSortedListItems sorts incoming batch and inplace-merges into existing vector, assuming existing items already follow same comparator. No verification of this precondition or runtime sortedness test performed.

Removal optionally owns/deletes row items through temporary unique_ptr after selection restoration, forgets async icon requests and erases map. DeleteAll also forgets requests before deleting owned items. Destructor alone is default; callers must execute explicit cleanup for owned rows.

PostSelectionChanged coalesces notifications but ignores PostMessage failure after setting pending flag. A failed post can leave later notifications suppressed until handler/other reset. No injected failure reproduced.

Column persistence enforces required visible columns and moves sorting off hidden keys. Width loading uses min(width,width*2), which is no positive upper clamp and can overflow for extreme stored int; upstream setting bounds and real input reachability unqualified.
Auto-fit on header divider scans every retained row, unlike tree expansion first50width sampling. Virtual list storage does not make this operation bounded by visible rows.

DrawPercentage uses supplied double fraction without clamp; prior extension logical/physical mixed-basis values can exceed1. Rendering bounds/finiteness require caller discipline and actual GUI tests.
limits: No Windows list selection, sorting invariants, duplicate-pointer ownership, post failure, column-width overflow, render/performance or cleanup tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
